B is a middle-ground GRR option, but its asserted primary/backup recommendation is not supported by a stated preference. C offers a nonstop and early arrival but trades that against an unspecified longer drive to DTW. D maximizes Friday daytime flexibility but arrives much later. Choosing among these tradeoffs requires unstated preferences about early starts, driving, nonstop value, and desired arrival time.
